# Droidex — Droidsmith's Registry

> Free collection tracker for Star Wars: Droid Tycoon, the Fortnite creative mode by FOAD/Blzn Studios (released May 1st, 2026). Track 200+ droids across 7 variants (Basic, Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Beskar, Galactic, Stellar), plan the 35 Rebirth levels across the 5 cycles, and know exactly which droids to keep physically in your base. Installable as a mobile PWA, works offline, English and French.

Key facts:

- The game gives no way to check what you already own while standing at the Sandcrawler shop; Droidex fills that gap.
- Each droid variant has 3 states: never owned, owned (Droidex entry), physically in base. A higher variant always satisfies a lower requirement (a Diamond droid validates a "Gold" requirement).
- Each Rebirth (1–35, across 5 cycles) requires 3 specific droids in your base plus credits; the tracker shows what is missing for your next target. Rebirth 28 is the first to require a Galactic-tier droid, rebirth 31 the first to require Stellar-tier droids.
- The Galactic variant (added mid-July 2026) is the 6th tier, above Beskar; the Stellar variant (added August 15, 2026, game patch v1.26 with rebirths 31-35 and a fifth cycle) is the 7th and newest tier. Like the in-game Droidex screen, all seven variants count toward one unified 442-variant total, shown alongside the game's Flawless x/62 counter; RB·GLC / RB·STL badges flag Galactic and Stellar rebirth requirements. A higher copy satisfies any lower variant requirement. Galactic income values are listed for every standard droid; Stellar values are completed at every data refresh.
- Beyond the checklist: per-droid wishlist (star the droids you are hunting for), Flawless tracking (mark which droids you already rolled Flawless), name search, quick filters with live counts (keep, missing for next rebirth, in base, wishlist, or by class Worker/Astromech/Battle), sorting by rarity or by Beskar income per second, a live variant total + collection bonus counter, and a live in-game player counter fed by Epic's official island stats API.
- Interface fully available in English and French (the only Droid Tycoon tracker that is).
- No account required: data stays in the browser (localStorage) with JSON export/import. Optional Google sign-in syncs the registry across devices.
- No tracking, no ads, free and open source (MIT).
- Self-hostable: static site (nginx) + optional PocketBase sync API, Docker/Traefik setup provided.

All four content pages below are also available in French under https://droidex.nackz.dev/fr/ (linked via hreflang; the language selector is in each page's header).

## Links

- [Application](https://droidex.nackz.dev/): the tracker itself
- [Value list](https://droidex.nackz.dev/value-list/): for every droid, income per second AND credit cost at each of the seven variants (Basic, Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Beskar, Galactic, Stellar) — one income table and one cost table per rarity. No other value list publishes the cost of every variant
- [Rebirth requirements](https://droidex.nackz.dev/rebirth-requirements/): the 3 droids and credit cost needed for each of the 35 rebirth levels, across all 5 cycles
- [Live stats](https://droidex.nackz.dev/stats/): how many people play Droid Tycoon right now, plus daily peak CCU, plays, unique players and retention — official Epic Ecosystem API data, archived daily since 2026-07-14 (Epic only keeps a 7-day window)
- [FAQ](https://droidex.nackz.dev/faq/): answers about variants (including the Galactic and Stellar tiers and every way to obtain them), rebirths, the full Flawless odds table (1 in 1000 at Basic down to 1 in 75 at Galactic, doubled by the Flawless Charm and again during events), the collection bonus, and syncing
- [Source code and documentation](https://github.com/n4ckz/droidex): README with self-hosting guide, game data sources and known data uncertainties
- [Game data file](https://github.com/n4ckz/droidex/blob/main/site/data.js): the tracked droids, rebirth requirements and credit costs
